entries.zh: 关节；骨节（骨与骨的接合处）
entries.en: joint; articulation (of the bones)

entries.zh: 裙的分节、接缝处（所指存疑）
entries.en: the joining or seam of a skirt (saya); sense uncertain
entries.notes: L 行 'saias'（裙）所指不明，H 節 仅泛表「节、段」，不能定夺具体部位。

entries.en: joint of the bones; bone joint
entries.notes: L 行 'aguas' 疑为 'huesos'（骨）之误录，与 H 骨輪 相合。

entries.en: finger joint; knuckle

entries.zh: 手部关节；指节（手背拳骨）
entries.en: joints of the hand; knuckles

entries.zh: 血脉（血管）的节结处；根节
entries.en: node or joint of a vein; root-joint
entries.notes: 'vena' 与 H 根節 的对应只能推知，取「脉之节结」义。

entries.zh: 骨节；一骨嵌入另一骨处的关节
entries.en: bone joint; the joint where one bone fits into another
to simmer or boil down (with bones); to make broth
to cook (food); to steam
entries.notes: H 作 炊 而 M/R 栏音写不合，字形疑为 爨（参第17条），义取「炊煮」。

entries.en: to boil; to cook (food) in water
to blanch; to boil (meat) briefly
entries.notes: H 煠 标 [疑]，L 'guibo' 费解，按「焯煮」义出释。

entries.en: to cook thoroughly; well-cooked, done
entries.notes: M 栏声调符号污损（T99），H 熟 与 L 义仍相合。

entries.en: to fire or bake pottery; earthenware
entries.notes: H 陶 明确（烧陶），M/R 音写标 [疑]，词义不受影响。

entries.en: to steam (cook without touching the water)

entries.zh: 蒸米饭；以少水蒸熟米饭
entries.en: to steam rice (cook rice with little water)
entries.notes: L 'mosqueta' 费解，疑误录，按 H 蒸米飯 定夺。

entries.zh: 白水煮（只用清水煮，不加他物）
entries.en: to boil in plain water only
entries.notes: L 'engua' 即 'en agua'；H 煠 标 [疑]，取「白煮」义。

entries.en: to cook (anything); to prepare food over fire
entries.notes: M 首音节声调污损（T99），H 炊爨 与 L 义相合。

entries.en: to boil until soft; to cook until it falls apart
to boil or prepare an ointment; to decoct a medicinal plaster
stove, hearth; kitchen
